bugs_found: fx_convert looks up rates with reversed key (to_currency, from_currency) instead of (from_currency, to_currency), causing wrong conversions or missing-rate errors
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when the minimum fee exceeds the amount
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce unexpected financial results
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal like the other functions, so float inputs can fail or behave inconsistently
